newer-schema.title: This data comes from a newer OXESpace
newer-schema.message: A newer version of OXESpace updated your data, and this version can't read it. Nothing was deleted. Install the newer version again, or restore the backup it made before updating.

corrupt.title: OXESpace's data file is damaged
corrupt.message: The database could not be read. Nothing was changed. Restore a backup from the backups folder, or send the details to support.

locked.title: OXESpace's data is in use
locked.message: Another program, or another OXESpace that is still closing, holds the database. Close it and open OXESpace again.

other.title: OXESpace couldn't open its data
other.message: Nothing was deleted. The details below say why; copy them for a bug report.

deferred.partMissing: Some commands may be missing from the palette and the menus until it loads. The rest of OXESpace keeps working.
deferred.activityMissing: Activity and notifications may not update until it loads. The rest of OXESpace keeps working.

report.failed: The report could not be prepared.
report.truncated: The text is too long for a link, so GitHub receives the first part. Use Copy text to share all of it.
